title: EKC attack-pattern properties (STIX 2.1 toplevel-property-extension)
description: Properties added to STIX attack-pattern objects in data/ekc-stix-2.1.json. The kill-chain phase is also carried in the standard kill_chain_phases property (kill_chain_name: extended-cyber-kill-chain-ai), so consumers that ignore extensions still get the stage.

x_ekc_id.description: EKC sub-technique ID, for example EKC-3.7. Also present as an external reference with source_name 'ekc'.

x_ekc_stage.description: Kill chain stage or Stage 7 sub-stage the sub-technique belongs to.

x_ekc_added_in.description: EKC version that introduced the sub-technique.

x_ekc_detection_signals.description: Behavioral signals a defender can act on. Present on sub-techniques that define their own signals; stage-level signals are in data/ekc.json.
